verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭੀਖ ਮਾਗਨਿ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਅਧੀਨਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aavat hai jaa kai bheekh maagan bhikhaaree dheen dhekhat adheeneh niraaso na biddaar hai ||

en.bdb: Whosoever is visited by a beggar for alms, impressed by his humility, the donor never turns him away disappointed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਆਸਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਡਾਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਅੰਤ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਤੋਰਿ ਟੂਕਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baiThat hai jaa kai dhuaar aasaa kai biddaar savaiaan a(n)t karunaa kai tor Took taeh ddaar hai ||

en.bdb: Whosoever has a dog coming to his door after discarding all other alternatives, the master of the house out of clemency serves him with a morsel of food.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਨ ਕੀ ਪਨਹੀ ਰਹਤ ਪਰਹਰੀ ਪਰੀ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pain kee panahee rahat paraharee paree taahoo kaahoo kaaj uTh chalat samaar hai ||

en.bdb: A shoe keeps lying unattended and uncared, but when its owner has to go out on some work, he too takes care of it then and uses it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਛਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੈ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਗਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੪॥
verses.translit_en: chhaadd aha(n)kaar chhaar hoi gur maarag mai kabahoo kai dhiaa kai dhiaal pag dhaar hai ||434||

en.bdb: Similarly, he who ever discards his ego and pride and lives in the refuge of the True Guru in utter humility like the dust of His feet, the clement True Guru will definitely shower His benevolence one day and attach him with His feet (He blesses him with His sermon).  (434)
